method: each wrong opening followed down the chain: ARCHON plan and elevation (read by eye) -> metric reader (callout rings, recogniser verdicts in calloutRings) -> solver steps and OPENING_GAP / DOOR_LEAVES_DEBUG traces (research/analyzer-n8-03b/steps.ts) -> emitted model -> compiled BuildWorld geometry (opening ledger)

rary.archon: 230/230; leaf ~0.8 m at the east jamb + fixed light; 2 fields on the garden elevation
rary.before: WINDOW 2.30 x 2.30 from the floor, 1 pane

chain.family: MULTI_PANEL_GLAZING: width >= 2.0 m to the floor; the plan's leaf was never asked (doorLeafFound only tests a leaf as wide as the gap)

rary.firstBad: FAMILY (classifyOpeningFamily + doorLeafFound): a leaf drawn shorter than the gap is not readable

rary.archon: 150/230; leaf ~0.8 m + fixed light (east jamb / west jamb)

chain.family: GLAZED_DOOR by width (1.3 < w < 2.0), no leaf read

rary.firstBad: LEAF READING (doorLeafFound tests only an arc of the gap's radius)

rary.archon: 400/230; no arc; 2 panes on the elevation
rary.before: WINDOW 4.00 x 2.30 from the floor, 1 pane

chain.fill: divisions 1: the plan draws no stub in the gap; the rear elevation reading (1.00..2.05 m) was refused against the printed 2.30 and carries no mullions

rary.firstBad: PANE DIVISION: no source the solver reads gives it
rary.why: a pane-count convention does not hold across the corpus (Cieszynianka's 2.31 m glazings are single panes, Marcówki's 4.70 m two): any threshold would be fitted to the benchmark

gozd.archon: 300/230; no arc (sliding); 2 panes on the elevation
gozd.before: WINDOW 2.97 x 1.30 on a 0.90 m sill (assumed)

chain.ring: callout-ring-recogniser-4bb6ff9145: width 300 accepted (p 0.998); height 230 refused (p 0.993, mean 0.862 < 0.9)
chain.extract: half-heard ring: the template's width (460) differs from the recogniser's 300, so the template's heights are dropped; no height candidate -> the ring is not published
chain.solver: no callout; elevations not registered (no ridge datum on the section) -> heights assumed

gozd.firstBad: METRIC READER (extract.ts): a ring whose height half fails only on the mean bound is dropped although the sheet reads 230 outright on 180/230

gozd.archon: 180/230; two leaves from both jambs meeting

chain.ring: width '10' (a digit dropped, unstable); height 150 refused on the mean; template 616/400 conf 0.10 -> rejected
chain.solver: no callout, no elevation; the glazing lines are drawn at luma 211..216 against the light-line cut < 215 -> 'no glazing' -> a door-wide empty gap on the ground storey is a door by convention

gozd.firstBad: METRIC READER (width half) and GLAZING SYMBOL threshold
gozd.why: lifting a dropped-digit width or moving the 215 cut by a grey level would be tuning to this sheet

chain.ring: width 200 accepted; height 230 unstable AND 4 glyphs of ink for 3 digits (the leader line runs through the ring)

gozd.firstBad: METRIC READER: the glyph gate refuses the height (correctly: it cannot tell a leader from a digit)

a01.note: side effect of the general leaf rule; verified on the ARCHON plan

separateCauses: Rarytasy: the plan's door symbol (a leaf shorter than its gap) — a solver rule. Goździkowce: the 300/230 height half dropped by the metric reader (a reader rule) plus the same leaf rule for 180/230. Two fixes, one per cause; neither forced on the other house.
